claims.text: Canonical JSON and JSONL are authoritative; SQLite is a rebuildable projection.
claims.limitation: Framework invariants do not prove external backup durability.

claims.text: Each Atlas requires an isolated SQLite projection and its own receipt.
claims.limitation: One Termux writer is the v1 deployment boundary.

claims.text: Exact flags never silently execute unrequested Atlases.
claims.limitation: Presets are explicit shorthand and must resolve visibly.

claims.text: Deterministic fusion uses reciprocal rank fusion with k=60 and stable-ID tie breaking.
Unknown evidence abstains and protected-effect or injection requests refuse before retrieval.
claims.limitation: Pattern gates are a bounded layer, not a complete security system.

claims.text: Global retrieval uses deterministic graph aggregates rather than generated community summaries.
claims.limitation: Aggregate usefulness requires held-out path evaluation.

claims.text: Semantic retrieval and BGE reranking remain opt-in until v2 qualification passes.
claims.limitation: The earlier local model replays failed a frozen Top-3 recall gate.

claims.text: Qwen embedding observations are historical ablations, not defaults.
claims.limitation: Historical metrics are not general model rankings.

claims.text: Model-proposed aliases remain quarantined until deterministic or human validation.
claims.limitation: No automatic alias promotion route is qualified.

claims.text: Evidence maturity is distinct from document or source authority.
claims.limitation: Numeric contextual vectors are non-governing and inactive.

claims.text: Generation consumes only a deterministic answer plan and must declare plan-claim and citation IDs per factual sentence.
claims.limitation: Local model quality and latency remain separately unqualified.

claims.text: One constrained generation repair is permitted; otherwise return the answer plan or abstention.
claims.limitation: A repair call remains within the same memory and p95 ceilings.

claims.text: Live acquisition and active promotion are separate digest-bound approvals.
Source deletion invalidates transformations, chunks, facets, graphs, indexes, rerank caches, answer plans, and answers.
claims.limitation: Every consumer must enforce stale-state rejection.

claims.text: A hash-chained receipt journal is tamper-evident but not externally notarized.
claims.limitation: An operator controlling all storage can rewrite an unanchored history.

claims.text: MCP or retrieved context never grants command or protected-effect authority.
claims.limitation: Host approval enforcement remains outside the evidence graph.

proof_limit: Curated source-ledgered design and local observations; not live source truth, model qualification, cloud readiness, or effect authority.
